spans.text: In a tactical control center in Area S09 under Griffin jurisdiction...
Gosh, I've been working at the warehouse all this time. I'm dead tired.
C'mon, Commander, stop pulling my leg. We just said hi at the mall, didn't we?!
Back to business. After Miss Helian left, HQ sent us a new assignment. Please take a look.
Though Scarecrow's destruction has been confirmed, a Griffin command post is still under Sangvis control.
Our squad in the area is surrounded by Sangvis troops. We must bust them out as soon as possible.
